text:
I came here to see Dr. Warangkana with a blocked middle ear after attending the hospital.  Dr. warangkana inspected my ears, nose, and throat.  She was nore thoroughly than the hospital ENT.  She found that when the hospital ENT had removed a hair from my ear that they had damaged my ear drum.  There was a small blood clot in my ear.

We discussed that I had a flight in a few days.  We discussed multiple treatment options and decided that a myringoplasty was the best option for removing the blockage.

Dr. Warangkana explained the procedure and the risks.  She the  expertly performed the procedure.  After 3 days, the ear was still blocked.

I returned to the clinic.  She examined my ear and showed me that the swelling in my ear had subsided.  She inspected my nose and throat again.  She wrote a detailed medical certificate noting all the medications and treatment for my doctor when I return to Australia.

About 2 hours after leavjng the clinic my ear began to feel air and then finally popped.

I flew to Bangkok. I followed the Dr. Instructions on the flight and the last of the blockage came out as the plane decended. My hearing has now fully returned.

Thank you so much for your immediate, kind, and honest treatment.  I am so thankful to have my hearing restored.

text: Dr. Warangkana was able to take me as a walk-in appointment.  I highly appreciated her ability to describe things for me in English and that she took the time to discuss alternative treatment options since I was still nursing my baby and couldn't take some of the stronger medications. Her afternoon and weekend clinic hours were convenient since I work during the day. Even thought the clinic is small, at the time she also had hours at Sriphat OPD and Bangkok hospital, so she was able to order a CT scan either one of those locations and I didn't need to explain my issues all over again to another doctor. Very flexible and easy to work with. If I even need to bring my children to an ENT I will bring them to her.
